integrity: All universal assertions are supported by the analytic proof in RESULT.md, with executable finite diagnostics separately labeled. The novelty comparison is best-knowledge, not a priority certificate.
scientific_limitations: Proved for fixed real p>0 on equal-price simple cyclic prisms only; no joint order-size scaling, heterogeneous prices, missing-edge robustness or independent verification. Noninteger spectral orders are mathematical interpolation losses and do not assert a particular physical noise model.
title: A half-order allocation transition for inverse Laplacian spectral moments on cyclic prisms
